name: Air Fryer Turkey Burgers with Potato Wedges

components.name: Turkey Patties
steps: Mix raw turkey, grated onion, mustard, garlic, parsley, onion powder and salt. Divide into four patties without compacting too tightly.
Heat air fryer to 180 C. Air fry turkey patties for approximately 12-15 minutes, flipping once, until 74 C inside.
Reheat patty and wedges thoroughly, then assemble in bun with raw vegetables at the time of eating.

components.name: Potato Wedges
steps: Toss raw potato wedges in oil, paprika and salt and air fry in two batches if needed at 200 C, shaking periodically, until tender and golden.

components.name: Bun & Salad
steps: Cool patties and wedges and store away from fresh buns, tomato and lettuce.
